verdict.rationale: Maritime documents a RESTful API for managing agents programmatically. It authenticates with Bearer tokens minted via `maritime keys create`, supports scoped keys, and is backed by TypeScript and Python SDKs, an eight-endpoint Files API and signed webhooks, all usable non-interactively by AI agents. Probes found no published OpenAPI/Swagger spec at standard paths, and all evidence is vendor docs. missing for 10: machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration of the API.
